messages:
sarah_product: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get a concise sequencing for three items that folks asked about: API rate-limits revamp, Console UI v2, and Optimize cost-suggestions? need windows to update customer comms.

omar_engineering: API rate-limits update — infra core work is finished. targeting internal alpha in Sprints 5-6 (roughly mid-May). public rollout depends on Dedicated testing & perf signoff. ETA ~2026-05-18. Will drop an RFC + perf numbers by EOD Friday. :memo:

jen_console: Console v2 status — we've split UX and backend. UX prototypes are in usability now; plan is beta (internal) end of Q2, external beta in June, GA aim mid-Q3. Backend pieces (billing/RBAC) land mid-Q3. Canary plan in draft, will ping @sarah_product for priority routes. :eyes:

leo_ml: Optimize (cost-suggestions) plan: two-phase rollout — phase 1 (June): default heuristics + safe suggestions surfaced in Console; phase 2 (Aug): per-tenant tuning + eval-driven thresholds. Need product to supply 3 canonical workloads for evaluation.

tara_research: question — will Optimize include quantization profile recs or just runtime knobs (batching, cache)?

jen_console: both, but quantization profiles will be opt-in initially. we'll expose a "suggested-quant" artifact in the Console that requires tenant approval.

omar_engineering: one more callout: rate-limit changes touch routing and kernel-selection heuristics in the runtime — could impact tail latency. plan is gradual rollout w/ model-variant fallback and continuous tracing. adding mitigation steps to the RFC (`fallback_model: true`, canary windows).

omar_engineering: example canary snippet we'll use for routing rollout:
```
routes:
  - match: /v1/generate
    policy: canary: 10%
    fallback: stable-2026-01
```

mike_ceo: thanks — sequencing looks sane. prioritize Dedicated customers for the API rollout and loop me in for the June beta customer call. happy to join to reduce churn. :thumbsup:

sarah_product: great — action items: OMAR: RFC + perf numbers by Friday; JEN: canary plan + beta invite list; LEO: supply eval datasets (3 workloads) by 6/1. I'll update the public roadmap doc and add these windows. if folks have blockers, add them inline here or ping me directly.

jen_console: adding my notes to the roadmap doc now, will tag the beta customers list.

leo_ml: uploading eval dataset proposals tomorrow, will include sample prompts and expected metrics.

omar_engineering: will post RFC link when live. expect some latency numbers there.

sarah_product: closing thread — thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
